name: Tsukiakari to Yokaze no Waltz
original_name: 月明かりと夜風のワルツ
source:
Rishua, a student aiming to become a magic researcher, has feelings for Lenard, a servant at her household. It won't be long until she graduates and has to leave home. That's why she has to confess her feelings before then...
But Rishua finds herself unable to do so.

--I know that he admires me.
And as much as it hurts me, I know that those feelings aren't romantic.

Days that pass by peacefully, doubts cast upon magic, a slightly turbulent presence.
This is the story of two people, who live in 'a world where magic exists'.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/8487]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
立志成为魔法研究员的学生莉舒亚对家中的仆人莱纳德产生了感情。过不了多久，她就要毕业了，就要离开家了。所以，在此之前，她必须要坦白自己的感情……
但Rishua发现自己做不到。

——我知道他很欣赏我。
尽管这让我很受伤，但我知道这些感觉并不浪漫。

日子平静地过去，对魔法的怀疑，略显动荡的存在。
这是生活在“存在魔法的世界”的两个人的故事。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/8487]NovelGame[/url]]
